dani: Quick q — I changed the default token bucket for the runtime rate limiter (config flag only). Do we bump patch? deploybot currently auto-bumps on PR merge.
liam: if users can observe behavior change at runtime i'd bump patch. safer.
maya: it's a pure default tweak, no API change; could we use buildmeta instead? e.g. 1.4.2+runtime.20240315 so semantic consumers don't get a new patch.
samir: My worry is release notes discoverability. If we skip patch users might miss it.
dani: deploybot will create a release draft automatically — if we decide to skip patch can we still surface the note?
ops-deploy-bot: deploybot created release draft for tag v1.4.2 with changelog auto-generated from commits. [link]
zara: proposal: decision matrix in PR description + label [skip-patch]. If label present then deploybot: 1) keep tag unchanged, 2) append buildmeta tag, 3) add notice to release notes header.
liam: need a rollback story — if a change slipped in and we didn't bump patch, pinning exact artifact by tag is harder.
maya: we can add an explicit 'deploy pin' step: when you want to pin, use full git SHA or the buildmeta tag we add (e.g., v1.4.2+rb-202315). That gives deterministic pins.
samir: ok what about the CI/deploybot heuristics? can we add a check: only allow skip-patch for changes matching this list: docs, config defaults, telemetry flags, build tooling.
dani: draft playbook below (copy into PR template):
```
SKIP-PATCH CRITERIA:
- No public API surface changes
- Config-only default flips
- Non-functional perf/telemetry flags
- No schema changes
PR LABELS: [skip-patch]
Deploybot behavior when [skip-patch] present:
- Do NOT increment patch number
- Create buildmeta: +bb.<shortsha>
- Add release note under 'Config tweaks (no semver bump)'
- Add machine-readable header for auditing
Rollback / Pinning:
- Use git SHA or full tag with buildmeta for pinning
- Ops: if rollback needed, create a hotpatch as normal (bump patch)
```

maya: also add a regression eval step flagged in console so we can auto-alert on perf deviation when skip-patch used :eyes:
liam: sgtm as long as ops can pin by SHA or buildmeta. +1
zara: i'll update the PR template and open a small RFC for releasebot change. tagging @platform to review the deploybot change
ops-deploy-bot: scheduled task: opened issue #1421 to implement skip-patch label handling.
